race.comment: THE MAGIC MAN (2) prefers to sit right up on the pace in his races and has been somewhat successful doing that recently. Two runs ago he was a dominant winner at Taree. Will get a lovely run all the way and has some weight relief too. SHOUTABOUTIT (6) resumes off some fair form lines. She placed both times here and has trialled nicely in the lead up. It's not a pretty barrier though. BLUE DANE (8) has been very consistent this time in. She is a fast horse but that last bit is the key. Will be in it for a long way. TAKE THE JACKPOT (3) goes best this distance. He is one who would prefer it on the softer side. ETERNAL EMBER (10) has the blinkers off now. She finally draws a gate to be able to race a bit closer.
